full_judgment: 3. Defendants contested the suit by filing a written statement asserting that their under-tenancy was never annulled and they were all along in possession. The defendants denied that late Kamaruddin or Samajuddin ever executed any Kabuliyat admitting annulment of their under tenancy or taking over Khas possession of the same by the plaintiffs stating that if there was any Kabuliyat by Kamaruddin that must have been manufactured for the purpose of the case. The defendants further asserted that since there was no annulment of the under-tenancy in question the suit land was recorded in the name of the predecessors-in-interest of the defendants during the petty and revisional settlement that took place after the purported auction-sale. Subsequently the suit land was recorded in the name of the defendants during the SA settlement.
